scene.notes: Square scene zooms the room independently; cauldron and effects rest on the ash inside the widened stone hearth.

liquid.notes: Blue for Moonwater, red for Ember Oil; mixed recipes tint the blue sheet to the recipe color. Upper mask preserves rising bubbles.

notes: Original PNG bytes are preserved. Source and target rectangles register the artwork within transparent frame padding; index.html uses these coordinates in SVG viewports. CSS advances each original sheet using its own native frame size.
